description: This file defines the Currency entity class for the shopizer project. It models currency data, including currency code, name, symbol, and support status, and maps to a database table for persistence.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Entity class representing a currency with fields for id, code, name, symbol, and support status, mapped to the CURRENCY table.

methods.name: Currency
methods.description: Default constructor for the Currency entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the currency object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the currency object.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the java.util.Currency object associated with this entity.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the java.util.Currency object and updates the currency code.

methods.name: getSupported
methods.description: Returns whether the currency is supported.

methods.name: setSupported
methods.description: Sets whether the currency is supported.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code, ensuring it matches the currency object's code.

methods.name: getSymbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol of the currency.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currency.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the currency.
